sources.title: Emissions from point sources
sources.publisher: National Atmospheric Emissions Inventory
sources.status: Known-location industrial and commercial point sources with grid references; 2023 XLSX available
sources.verified_fact: Known-location point sources have grid references and can be mapped directly; 2023 point-source workbook is published.
sources.quality_effect: Adds direct facility-location candidate evidence; parcel binding remains a separate unexecuted gate.

sources.title: Gridded Emissions Data
sources.publisher: National Atmospheric Emissions Inventory
sources.surface: Official NAEI 1×1 km gridded and point-source download
sources.status: Annual 1×1 km grids plus point-source SHP/CSV coordinates for 2005-2023
sources.verified_fact: Downloads include ASCII and GeoTIFF 1×1 km grids plus point-source SHP/CSV site coordinates for greenhouse gases including CO2, methane and nitrous oxide.
sources.quality_effect: Adds spatial screening candidates and coordinate-bearing facility context; no parcel value inferred.

sources.title: UK Spatial Emissions Methodology - National Atmospheric Emissions Inventory 2023
sources.publisher: National Atmospheric Emissions Inventory
sources.status: Reissued methodology; corrected charts while accompanying gridded data remained valid
sources.verified_fact: The reissued report documents spatial allocation methodology and states the corrected chart issue did not affect accompanying gridded data.
sources.quality_effect: Raises methodology traceability and prevents treating spatial grids as direct parcel measurements.

sources.title: Pollution Inventory
sources.publisher: Environment Agency
sources.surface: National Data Library official regulated-site release dataset
sources.status: 2024 dataset available; annual mass releases from large regulated industrial sites
sources.verified_fact: The dataset covers annual mass releases to air, controlled waters and sewers from large regulated industrial sites, including point, non-point and fugitive releases; EPSG:27700 metadata is provided.
sources.quality_effect: Adds regulated-site emissions evidence and spatial-reference metadata; conditional licence limits are recorded.
sources.licence_note: Environment Agency Conditional Licence; permitted-use period and reuse restrictions must be checked before production use.

sources.title: Environmental Permitting Regulations - Industrial Sites
sources.publisher: Environment Agency
sources.surface: National Data Library official industrial-site register
sources.status: Daily-updated EPR process-industry site register with EPSG:27700 metadata
sources.verified_fact: The register covers process-industry installations and larger waste activities with potentially significant releases; spatial reference EPSG:27700 and daily update frequency are stated.
sources.quality_effect: Adds current regulated-facility identity/location candidates; licence and personal-data constraints are recorded.
sources.licence_note: Environment Agency Conditional Licence is limited to one year and includes personal-data compliance conditions.

sources.title: Download industrial emissions and waste transfer (UK PRTR) data
sources.publisher: Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs
sources.surface: GOV.UK annual UK PRTR XML datasets
sources.status: 2024 UK PRTR XML dataset and historical annual datasets available
sources.verified_fact: The official publication provides the 2024 UK PRTR XML dataset and previous reporting years.
sources.quality_effect: Adds a current industrial facility emissions crosscheck; reporting thresholds prevent absence from being treated as zero.
sources.licence_note: Resource-level reuse terms must be checked before production ingestion.

sources.title: UK Pollutant Release and Transfer Register data sets
sources.publisher: Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs
sources.surface: GOV.UK UK PRTR scope, quality and method guidance
sources.status: Facility geography, thresholds, quality checks and reporting method codes documented
sources.verified_fact: Records include facility location; regulators crosscheck permits, inspections and monitoring; values may be measured, calculated, estimated or unspecified.
sources.quality_effect: Prevents threshold gaps and non-reporting from being interpreted as measured zero.

sources.title: Annual CO2 emissions from regulated installation operators
sources.publisher: Environment Agency
sources.surface: National Data Library official England installation emissions workbook
sources.status: Annual CO2e for permitted England installations; EPSG:27700 and OGL stated
sources.verified_fact: The dataset describes annual CO2-equivalent emissions from regulated installations in England with annual frequency and spatial metadata.
sources.quality_effect: Adds England installation crosschecks; historical 2013-2020 coverage is retained as a limitation.
sources.licence_note: Open Government Licence; ETSWAP lineage and historical period recorded.

sources.title: UK ETS Public Reports
sources.publisher: UK Emissions Trading Scheme Registry
sources.status: Installation account-holder/allocation and 2021-2025 emissions-surrender compliance reports available
sources.verified_fact: Public reports expose installation operator and allocation records and a compliance report covering emissions and allowances surrendered for 2021-2025.
sources.quality_effect: Adds operator identity and verified compliance-emissions crosschecks without implying coordinates.

sources.title: Greenhouse Gas Emissions Data
sources.publisher: National Atmospheric Emissions Inventory
sources.status: Current inventory selectors, machine-readable data, point, grid and map products catalogued
sources.verified_fact: The official catalogue identifies current inventory products and publication cycles including point, grid and local-authority products.
sources.quality_effect: Adds release-version and freshness reconciliation across NAEI-derived candidates.

sources.title: Maps
sources.publisher: National Atmospheric Emissions Inventory
sources.surface: Official emissions map and spatial-download catalogue
sources.status: 1x1 km, local-authority and individual-site products documented; OGL statement present
sources.verified_fact: The map catalogue describes emissions at 1x1 km, local-authority and individual-site levels where possible and links spatial downloads.
sources.quality_effect: Adds a completeness index while retaining resolution limits.
sources.licence_note: Open Government Licence except where a product states otherwise.

sources.title: UK greenhouse gas emissions: final
sources.publisher: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero
sources.surface: National Data Library accredited official statistics
sources.status: Final UK territorial estimates from 1990 with source, end-user and SIC releases
sources.verified_fact: Accredited official statistics provide final UK territorial totals and source/end-user/SIC breakdowns.
sources.quality_effect: Adds national control totals only and is not a facility or parcel source.
